### macOS Universal 2.3.9

For Intel and Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14.4 or later.

- **Image Editor controls** · Enter coordinates, dimensions, angles, and opacity in wider numeric fields without stepper arrows.
- **On-canvas text** · Click the image and type. Change font size during the edit and resize committed text with the layer handles. Press Command-Return to commit or Esc to cancel. Command-Z and Shift-Command-Z undo and redo committed edits.
- **Excel workbooks in Reference** · Open .xlsx files in an offline, read-only grid. Switch worksheets, select and copy cells, and view saved formula results. Formulas without saved results show “Result unavailable.”
- **Worksheet navigation on macOS** · Fixed an accessibility crash when jumping across a large worksheet. The focused grid exposes the current cell address and value.

- **PDF Reference** · The document arrows, continuous page scrolling, and annotation undo and redo remain available.

Built and tested on an Intel Mac Pro. The app is signed ad hoc. Every bundled Mach-O file contains x86_64 and arm64 slices. The arm64 slices were checked structurally.

Source commit: `cdf9f54b9e1e418d6ee0562e5221372908c7529c`. The corresponding source archive, third-party notices and source references, and SHA-256 checksums accompany the DMG.

The separate native arm64 DMG for M-series Macs includes the same 2.3.9 Image Editor controls, editable on-canvas text, offline Excel preview and large worksheet accessibility fix, and PDF Reference features. It requires macOS 14.4 or later and is signed ad hoc.
